snippet.title: What Is Robinhood Gold? Is It Worth The Cost?
snippet.description:
About this video: Ever wonder how the Robinhood app makes money? Robinhood has a special paid membership known as Robinhood Gold that allows users to buy and sell stocks on margin. With Robinhood Gold, you can double your buying power to make more money in the stock market. But just remember that just as quickly as you can make money while margin trading, you can also lose a great deal of money while participating in such risky activities. 
Margin trading is not for everyone. I personally have traded on margin in the past with success but it is not something I would recommend for investors who are just starting to get into the market. Trust me, nothing is scarier than when the stock you bought on margin is plummeting double digits! I am talking from experience! 

With all of this being said, if you are going to trade stocks on margin I would recommend using Robinhood Gold due to their simplicity and straightforward, no fills attached trading platform.

snippet.title: How To Calculate Beta on Excel - Linear Regression & Slope Tool
snippet.description:
Learn how to calculate Beta on Microsoft Excel with this step-by-step tutorial! This simple, yet easy to understand video provides you with the ability to calculate the beta of any company’s stock price.
Beta is typically used by investors to evaluate the risk of investing into a certain stock. Many financial institutions provide a list of company’s beta, but they can sometimes be inaccurate. Calculating Beta on your own is the only way to be sure you are receiving the correct information. The worst part about using a pre-calculated beta provided by someone else is that you are unaware of the time period that was taken into consideration when calculating that beta. By calculating it yourself you will know the exact span of time that your beta includes and you will have much more flexibility when calculating the desired time span.
